messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Rotate the entire part by 90 degrees about the X axis.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response: {"match": true, "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "The edited part shows the vertical capsule rotated 90 degrees to lie horizontally along the depth axis (Y), which is consistent with a rotation about the X axis, transforming the top view from a circle (end view) to a vertical capsule (side view) and moving the hole from the top face to the front/left face."}
